en.description: 8-inch 1200p 120Hz VRR display with Ryzen Z2 Extreme, 32GB RAM, and the largest 80Wh battery in its class — the cooler-running Windows alternative to the Ally X.

zh-tw.description: 8 吋 1200p 120Hz VRR 螢幕，搭 Ryzen Z2 Extreme、32GB RAM 和同級最大的 80Wh 電池，是 Ally X 之外溫度控制更好的 Windows 對手。

en.description: First non-Valve handheld officially shipping with SteamOS — Z1 Extreme, 32GB RAM, 8-inch 120Hz VRR LCD, and a real shot at Steam Deck buyers shut out by stock shortages.

en.description: Slide-up physical QWERTY keyboard, Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, 6-inch 144Hz screen — the only mainstream handheld in 2026 that lets you actually type without docking.

Steam Deck OLED in 2026 Review: Performance, Value, and Buying Advice

en.commentary:
2026 is the first year the handheld market makes sense as a single comparison instead of three siloed conversations. Switch 2 is finally out, the ROG Xbox Ally X has shipped, the Legion Go 2 and Claw 8 AI+ ended the year-long preview cycle, and Steam Deck OLED is still the king of the SteamOS ecosystem. I ranked these the way an actual buyer would rank them — by what you do on day one, not by spec sheets.

Steam Deck OLED takes first place because it is the only handheld in this list that costs $649 and asks nothing else from you. Boot it up, sign in, and your existing Steam library is downloading. SteamOS is faster, more polished, and more battery-efficient than Windows on every Windows handheld in this comparison, and Valve's hardware team kept the weight and grip geometry right. The 7.4-inch HDR OLED at 90Hz is still the best display-to-price ratio in the category. The only real warning is stock — Valve has been chronically out of the 1TB SKU through Q1 2026, and refurbished units are now the most reliable way to buy.

Switch 2 is second on a different axis entirely. You do not buy it to compete with PC handhelds on performance. You buy it because Mario Kart World, the new Donkey Kong, and the entire first-party Switch 2 catalog only exist on this hardware. The 7.9-inch HDR LCD at 120Hz, 4K dock output, and a $449.99 price tag make it the most accessible handheld in the comparison and the only one that families and casual players should consider first. If you only buy one gaming handheld in 2026 and you are not already on PC, this is it.

The ROG Xbox Ally X is third and represents the largest single-year improvement of any handheld in this list. The 80Wh battery, 24GB of RAM, 1TB SSD, and the new Xbox full-screen experience that finally hides the Windows desktop make this the first Windows handheld I would recommend without an asterisk. At $999.99, it is twice the Switch 2 and you should know exactly why you are paying for that — Game Pass on the go, full Steam, full Epic, mod support, and the headroom to actually run 2026 AAA games at native resolution.

Legion Go 2 at four wins on raw spec ambition. The 8.8-inch 144Hz OLED is the best display on any handheld and the detachable controllers plus kickstand are genuinely useful for travel and couch play. It is heavier and more expensive than the Ally X, and the Lenovo software shell is still rougher than what Asus and Microsoft built together, which is why it sits one rank lower despite the better screen.

MSI Claw 8 AI+ is fifth and quietly excellent. Its Intel-based predecessors were thermally compromised, but the Ryzen Z2 Extreme refresh closed the gap and the 80Wh battery matches the Ally X. It loses points only because the Ally X has the platform-level Xbox integration that MSI cannot replicate.

Legion Go S with SteamOS at six is the most interesting story in the category — Valve licensed SteamOS to a third party, and the result is a real Steam Deck alternative for buyers who cannot find one in stock. The Z1 Extreme is roughly Steam Deck OLED level in real-world games, and the 8-inch 120Hz screen is bigger if not as bright as Valve's OLED.

AYANEO 3 and GPD Win 4 close out the list at seven and eight, and they are there for the enthusiasts who already know they want them. Modular face controllers, OCuLink for external GPUs, sliding QWERTY keyboards — these are wonderful niche features and they justify the price for the right buyer. For anyone else, the top six exist for a reason.

highlights.title: Steam Deck OLED is still the only handheld where the software is the feature, not the obstacle
highlights.body: Every Windows handheld in this list is fighting against Windows. SteamOS is the inverse — it boots straight into a console-style game launcher, manages cloud saves and proton compatibility automatically, sleeps and resumes flawlessly, and ships with controller-native menus everywhere. The Z2 Extreme handhelds beat the Steam Deck OLED on raw FPS, but the Steam Deck wins on actually getting to those FPS without 20 minutes of driver and overlay troubleshooting. At $649 for the 1TB OLED model, it remains the highest-confidence purchase in the category.

highlights.title: The Switch 2 is the only $449 console in the world that runs Mario Kart World
highlights.body: Hardware comparisons miss the point on this one. Switch 2 sits in a parallel market where the question is not 'how does it benchmark against the Ally X' but 'do you want to play the new 3D Mario, the new Zelda, the new Donkey Kong, and the new Pokemon on a portable.' First-party Nintendo games stay exclusive and the price is half of what a comparable Windows handheld costs. For the family-buyer market, the casual-buyer market, and the lapsed-gamer market, this is the entire conversation.

highlights.title: The ROG Xbox Ally X is the first Windows handheld I trust without a but
highlights.body: Two things changed in 2026. The 80Wh battery turned the Ally line from a four-hour handheld into a six-hour handheld. And the Xbox full-screen experience finally boots straight into a Series-S-style game launcher that hides the Windows desktop entirely. Combined with 24GB of RAM, a 1TB SSD, and impulse triggers, this is the first time a Windows handheld has felt like a console product instead of a desktop in disguise. At $999.99 it is expensive, but it is the only handheld in the list that runs Steam, Game Pass, Epic, and 2026 AAA games on the same device with no compromises.

highlights.title: Legion Go 2 has the best screen, MSI Claw 8 AI+ has the best thermals, and both lose narrowly to the Ally X
highlights.body: Lenovo's 8.8-inch 144Hz OLED is genuinely the prettiest panel in the category and the detachable controllers solve a real problem for desk and couch use. MSI's 80Wh battery and quieter cooling are measurable wins. But neither manages the platform-level integration that Microsoft and Asus built into the Ally X, and at this price point the software experience is what separates a $1,000 device that you actually use from one that ends up in a drawer.

highlights.title: Legion Go S with SteamOS is the answer to 'I cannot find a Steam Deck OLED in stock'
highlights.body: Valve licensing SteamOS to Lenovo is the single most consequential platform move of 2026 for handheld gaming. Z1 Extreme matches Steam Deck OLED performance closely in real games, the 8-inch 120Hz LCD is bigger than Valve's screen, and crucially, the Legion Go S is actually available to buy. Buyers who tried for months to grab a 1TB Steam Deck OLED and gave up should put this on their shortlist immediately.

zh-tw.commentary:
2026 年是手持遊戲機市場第一次可以放在同一張桌子上比較的一年。Switch 2 終於上市、ROG Xbox Ally X 出貨、Legion Go 2 和 Claw 8 AI+ 結束一整年的預告期，Steam Deck OLED 也還是 SteamOS 陣營的王者。這份排行我是用一般人實際買回家會怎麼用的角度來排，而不是看規格表。

Steam Deck OLED 排第一，因為這份名單裡只有它買回家不需要再跟系統打架。一台 21,000 元出頭，開機登入，你的 Steam 遊戲庫就在下載。SteamOS 比這次比較裡所有 Windows 掌機都跑得更順、更省電，Valve 硬體團隊把重量和握把角度也抓得剛好，7.4 吋 HDR OLED 90Hz 螢幕在這個價位還是同級最強。唯一要注意的是缺貨，1TB 版本在 2026 年第一季幾乎一直缺，目前比較穩的買法反而是去買 Valve 官網翻新機。

Switch 2 排第二是另一個維度的勝出。買這台不是為了跟 PC 掌機比效能，是因為 Mario Kart World、新 Donkey Kong、整個 Switch 2 第一方陣容只有這台機器玩得到。7.9 吋 HDR LCD 120Hz、接基座輸出 4K、台幣不到 14,000 的入手價，是這份名單裡門檻最低的一台。如果你 2026 年只想買一台掌機而且本來就不是 PC 玩家，那答案就是它。

ROG Xbox Ally X 排第三，是這份名單裡單年進步幅度最大的一台。80Wh 電池、24GB RAM、1TB SSD、新的 Xbox 全螢幕體驗終於把 Windows 桌面藏起來，這是我第一次推薦 Windows 掌機可以不加但書。台幣三萬多是 Switch 2 的兩倍多，你買它的理由要很清楚，Game Pass 隨身玩、Steam、Epic、Mod 支援、跑 2026 年 AAA 大作都沒問題。

Legion Go 2 排第四，規格野心最大。8.8 吋 144Hz OLED 是同級最強的螢幕，可拆式手把加內建支架對出差和沙發玩確實實用。但比 Ally X 重、貴，Lenovo 的軟體層做得也比微軟跟華碩聯手做出來的粗糙，所以螢幕雖然贏，整體還是排在後一名。

MSI Claw 8 AI+ 排第五，是低調但表現很好的一台。前一代 Intel 版本散熱有問題，但這次換 Ryzen Z2 Extreme 之後追上來了，80Wh 電池跟 Ally X 一樣大。扣分的地方在於 Ally X 有 Xbox 平台層級的整合，MSI 做不出來這層體驗。

Legion Go S 跑 SteamOS 排第六，是這個品類最有趣的故事。Valve 把 SteamOS 授權給第三方，買不到 Steam Deck 的人現在有真正的替代品。Z1 Extreme 在實際遊戲表現大概等於 Steam Deck OLED，8 吋 120Hz 螢幕比 Valve 那塊大，雖然亮度不到 OLED 那麼漂亮。

AYANEO 3 和 GPD Win 4 排七、八，是給已經知道自己要什麼的發燒友玩的。模組化手把面板、OCuLink 外接顯卡、滑蓋實體鍵盤，這些都是非常棒的小眾功能，但如果你不知道自己需不需要，那前六名才是你該看的選項。

highlights.title: Steam Deck OLED 還是唯一一台軟體是賣點而不是阻礙的掌機
highlights.body: 這份名單裡每一台 Windows 掌機都在跟 Windows 對抗。SteamOS 反過來，開機直接進主機風格的遊戲啟動器，雲端存檔、Proton 相容性自動處理，睡眠喚醒順暢無痛，所有選單都是手把優先設計。Z2 Extreme 的掌機在純 FPS 數字上贏過 Steam Deck OLED，但 Steam Deck 贏在實際開機 20 分鐘內你就在玩遊戲，而不是還在處理驅動和疊加層。一台 1TB OLED 版本台幣 21,000 元，是這個品類最有把握的一筆消費。

highlights.title: Switch 2 是全世界唯一一台 14,000 元就能玩 Mario Kart World 的主機
highlights.body: 比規格在這台機器上沒意義。Switch 2 站在平行宇宙，問題不是「跟 Ally X 跑分差多少」，是「想不想在掌機上玩新 3D Mario、新 Zelda、新 Donkey Kong、新寶可夢」。任天堂第一方遊戲就是只在這台機器上獨佔，價格只要同級 Windows 掌機的一半。家庭買家、休閒玩家、回鍋玩家，這台就是答案，沒有第二個選項要討論。

highlights.title: ROG Xbox Ally X 是我第一次推薦不用加但書的 Windows 掌機
highlights.body: 2026 年有兩件事改變了這條產品線。80Wh 電池把 Ally 從四小時掌機升級到六小時掌機。Xbox 全螢幕體驗終於開機直接進 Series S 風格的啟動器，把 Windows 桌面完全藏起來。再加上 24GB RAM、1TB SSD、震動扳機，這是第一次有 Windows 掌機讓我覺得它真的是主機產品，不是偽裝成主機的桌機。台幣三萬多是貴，但它是這份名單裡唯一一台可以同時跑 Steam、Game Pass、Epic 和 2026 年 AAA 大作完全沒妥協的機器。

highlights.title: Legion Go 2 螢幕最強、MSI Claw 8 AI+ 散熱最好，但兩台都微幅輸給 Ally X
highlights.body: Lenovo 那塊 8.8 吋 144Hz OLED 是同級最漂亮的螢幕，可拆式手把對桌上型和沙發玩確實有解決問題。MSI 的 80Wh 電池和更安靜的散熱也是可量測的優勢。但這兩家都沒辦法做到微軟和華碩聯手在 Ally X 上做到的平台層整合，在這個價位帶，軟體體驗才是決定一台台幣三萬多的掌機你會天天用還是丟在抽屜的關鍵。

highlights.title: Legion Go S 的 SteamOS 版，是「我買不到 Steam Deck OLED」的標準答案
highlights.body: Valve 把 SteamOS 授權給 Lenovo 是 2026 年掌機平台最重要的單一事件。Z1 Extreme 在實際遊戲表現上跟 Steam Deck OLED 接近，8 吋 120Hz 螢幕比 Valve 那塊大，最重要的是 Legion Go S 真的買得到。已經試了好幾個月想搶 1TB Steam Deck OLED 結果搶不到的人，這台應該直接放進清單。

en.commentary: Handheld gaming consoles are the most contested category of 2026 and the rankings have a clear story. Steam Deck OLED holds first because Valve continues to ship the best value-per-dollar handheld and SteamOS has matured into the most polished handheld OS. The OLED screen, the trackpads for non-controller games, and the modding community give it a depth no Windows handheld matches. Nintendo Switch 2 at #2 is the first-party games argument and at $450 it is the only handheld that plays Mario Kart World, Donkey Kong Bananza, and the upcoming Metroid Prime 4. ROG Xbox Ally X at #3 is the Windows handheld that finally got the OS right — Microsoft's Xbox handheld mode strips Windows down to a real handheld interface. Lenovo Legion Go 2 at #4 is the detachable-controller niche pick. MSI Claw 8 AI+ at #5 is the Intel handheld for buyers who want Intel for some reason. Lenovo Legion Go S SteamOS at #6 is interesting because it brings SteamOS to a non-Valve handheld. AYANEO 3 at #7 and GPD Win 4 (2025) at #8 are the boutique enthusiast picks. Pick Steam Deck OLED for everything except first-party Nintendo games.

highlights.title: Steam Deck OLED holds first because SteamOS is the only handheld OS that respects the form factor
highlights.body: Windows on a handheld still requires the on-screen keyboard for half the menus. SteamOS on the Deck OLED is built for the controller and the screen size from the ground up. The trackpads make non-controller games playable. At $549 for the 512GB model it is half the price of the ROG Xbox Ally X and the better handheld.

highlights.title: Nintendo Switch 2 is the first-party games argument and that argument wins
highlights.body: Mario Kart World, Donkey Kong Bananza, and the upcoming Metroid Prime 4 will only ever run on a Switch. At $450 the Switch 2 is the second handheld I tell people to buy after the Steam Deck OLED, and the only handheld that plays the games Nintendo refuses to port.

highlights.title: ROG Xbox Ally X is the Windows handheld that finally got the OS right
highlights.body: Microsoft's Xbox handheld mode strips Windows down to a real handheld interface. The AMD Ryzen Z2 Extreme is the most powerful chip in any handheld. At $1,000 it is twice the Steam Deck OLED price and only worth it if you specifically need Windows-only games or hardware acceleration the Steam Deck cannot do.

highlights.title: Lenovo Legion Go 2 is the right detachable-controller pick if that matters
highlights.body: The detachable controllers fix the only Switch 2 weakness — the joycon drift. Lenovo's controller engineering is a generation ahead. At $899 it is priced against the ROG Ally X and the choice is whether you want detachable controllers or raw performance.

highlights.title: AYANEO 3 and GPD Win 4 (2025) are boutique picks for enthusiasts only
highlights.body: Both are excellent handhelds with Windows that work, but at $1,200-plus they cost twice the Steam Deck OLED for marginal performance gains. Buy them if you specifically want a clamshell or a slider form factor. Otherwise, the Steam Deck OLED is the better value at every angle.

zh-tw.commentary: 手持遊戲機是 2026 年競爭最激烈的品類，排行有很清楚的故事線。Steam Deck OLED 守住第一是因為 Valve 持續推出最高 CP 值機型，SteamOS 成熟成最完整的手持作業系統。OLED 螢幕、給非控制器遊戲用的觸控板、改機社群深度，沒有任何 Windows 掌機能比。Nintendo Switch 2 排第二是第一方遊戲論述，台灣 13,500 元是唯一能玩 Mario Kart World、Donkey Kong Bananza、即將推出的 Metroid Prime 4 的掌機。ROG Xbox Ally X 排第三是終於把作業系統做對的 Windows 掌機，微軟 Xbox 手持模式把 Windows 砍成真正掌機介面。Lenovo Legion Go 2 排第四是可拆控制器的小眾選擇。MSI Claw 8 AI+ 排第五是想要 Intel 的買家用的。Lenovo Legion Go S SteamOS 排第六很有意思，把 SteamOS 帶到非 Valve 掌機。AYANEO 3 排第七、GPD Win 4 (2025) 排第八是發燒友精品選擇。除了任天堂第一方遊戲外，全部選 Steam Deck OLED。

highlights.title: Steam Deck OLED 守住第一是因為 SteamOS 是唯一尊重手持形式的作業系統
highlights.body: Windows 在掌機上一半的選單還是要叫出螢幕鍵盤。SteamOS 在 Deck OLED 從頭到尾為控制器跟螢幕尺寸設計。觸控板讓非控制器遊戲可以玩。512GB 版台灣 17,000 元是 ROG Xbox Ally X 一半的價格，而且是更好的掌機。

highlights.title: Nintendo Switch 2 是第一方遊戲論述，這個論述贏了
highlights.body: Mario Kart World、Donkey Kong Bananza、即將推出的 Metroid Prime 4 永遠只在 Switch 上跑。台灣 13,500 元是 Steam Deck OLED 之後我推薦的第二台掌機，也是唯一能玩任天堂不肯移植的遊戲的選擇。

highlights.title: ROG Xbox Ally X 是終於把作業系統做對的 Windows 掌機
highlights.body: 微軟 Xbox 手持模式把 Windows 砍成真正掌機介面。AMD Ryzen Z2 Extreme 是任何掌機最強的晶片。台灣 33,000 元是 Steam Deck OLED 兩倍價，只有特別需要 Windows 限定遊戲或 Steam Deck 跑不動的硬體加速才值得。

highlights.title: Lenovo Legion Go 2 是可拆控制器派的正解
highlights.body: 可拆控制器解決 Switch 2 唯一弱點，就是 Joy-Con 漂移。Lenovo 的控制器工程領先一個世代。台灣 30,000 元定價打 ROG Ally X，要可拆控制器還是要原始效能而已。

highlights.title: AYANEO 3 跟 GPD Win 4 (2025) 是發燒友精品選擇
highlights.body: 兩台都是 Windows 跑得動的優秀掌機，但台灣 40,000 元以上是 Steam Deck OLED 兩倍價，效能進步有限。要折疊式或滑蓋式形式才買它們。否則 Steam Deck OLED 在每個角度都是更好的性價比。

en.commentary: I've spent the better part of April rotating between five handhelds on planes, couches, and a hotel room in Taipei, and the verdict landed firmer than I expected. en.commentary: Pricing turbulence is reshaping this category, and it is why I am holding my order steady rather than reacting. Valve raised the Steam Deck OLED price by 240 dollars in May, citing higher memory and storage costs, and Nintendo has confirmed a 50 dollar bump on the Switch 2 coming in September. The wider RAMageddon, the AI-driven spike in memory prices, is hitting every maker at once. Even with the increase, the Steam Deck OLED keeps my top spot. Its 7.4-inch HDR OLED at up to 90Hz still produces the bright color and deep blacks that define the handheld experience, and SteamOS remains the most polished portable platform with the deepest verified library. The Switch 2 holds second and is simply the best way to play Nintendo games in 2026, with its 7.9-inch 1080p 120Hz LCD, 256GB of storage, and 4K docked output via a custom Nvidia chip. If you can buy before September, do it and save the 50 dollars. The ROG Xbox Ally X stays third as the performance pick. Its Ryzen Z2 Extreme, 24GB of RAM, and fast 1TB SSD chew through demanding games that bring the Switch 2 and Steam Deck to their knees, and it wins by default if you want serious horsepower without a near-1,000-dollar Legion Go 2. Below that, the Legion Go 2 and MSI Claw 8 AI+ hold their spots for spec chasers, and the SteamOS Legion Go S remains a strong value entry. My advice this week is timing-driven. If you want a handheld, the smart move is to buy before the next round of price hikes lands.

en.commentary:
A genuine market event reshuffles the top of this list. On May 27, Valve raised Steam Deck OLED prices significantly, the 512GB model jumping from $549 to $789 and the 1TB from $649 to $949, citing the RAM and NAND flash shortage driven by AI data-center demand. The Steam Deck OLED held the top spot largely on an unbeatable value score, and at nearly 44% more expensive that argument no longer holds. It is still a superb handheld with its 7.4-inch HDR OLED screen, vast verified library, and excellent ergonomics, so it drops only to rank 2 rather than falling out of contention.

The Nintendo Switch 2 takes over rank 1 as a result. Its pricing is unaffected by this swing, and it is the definitive way to play Nintendo games in 2026. The 7.9-inch LCD supports HDR and runs up to 120fps, and docked it outputs 4K to compatible TVs. With the value calculus shifting, the Switch 2's combination of a stable price, a first-party library nothing else can match, and a polished hardware experience makes it the new front-runner.

The ASUS ROG Xbox Ally X holds rank 3 as the most powerful handheld PC option, with its Ryzen Z2 Extreme chip, 24GB of RAM, and up to 35W when plugged in, though its $1,000 price keeps it a premium pick. The Lenovo Legion Go 2 at rank 4 and MSI Claw 8 AI+ at rank 5 round out the high-performance Windows tier. The bigger story is that the RAM and NAND shortage is now hitting handheld pricing directly, and buyers should expect this pressure to persist through summer 2026. If you want a Steam Deck OLED, the value proposition has changed, and weighing it against the steady-priced Switch 2 is now the right move.

For maximum horsepower the ROG Xbox Ally X remains the one to beat, its Ryzen Z2 Extreme chip, 24GB of RAM, and higher power draw make it the clear choice for demanding PC games if you can stomach the cost. The Lenovo Legion Go 2, with its 8.8-inch 144Hz OLED, is the large-screen alternative arriving this month. My rankings hold this week, the hierarchy is settled: Switch 2 for value and exclusives, Steam Deck for the PC library, Ally X for raw power.

en.commentary: This is a genuinely tricky month to shop, and the pricing news is doing most of the talking. Valve raised the Steam Deck OLED by a steep amount in May, and the 512GB model now lands close to far more powerful Windows handhelds. The Deck is still a joy to hold and its SteamOS experience is the smoothest in the category, so I kept it at third, but I trimmed its value mark to reflect what you actually pay today. The Nintendo Switch 2 stays my number one for most people. Its library is unmatched, the hardware is comfortable for long sessions, and even with the MSRP rising to 499 dollars on September 1, buying now still captures the better price. If you want raw Windows power, the ROG Xbox Ally X holds second with its Ryzen Z2 Extreme, 24GB of RAM, and a 1TB SSD that chews through modern titles. The big arrival this month is the Lenovo Legion Go 2, shipping in June with an 8.8 inch screen and the same Z2 Extreme silicon. I nudged its ergonomics up a touch after more hands-on time with its grips, and it ties the Deck on overall score now. At 1,199 dollars it is a premium swing, so I would only point enthusiasts there. My short advice this week: grab the Switch 2 before September if value matters, choose the Ally X for the deepest PC library, and look at the Legion Go 2 if you want the flashiest screen.

en.commentary: The Steam Deck OLED still earns my recommendation for anyone with a deep Steam library, but I am adjusting its value score this week and I want to be honest about why. In May, Valve raised the price by roughly 240 dollars, citing higher memory and storage component costs. That is a real change to the math I use when I tell someone where their money goes furthest. The hardware is the same excellent device it was a month ago, with the best display in the category and ergonomics that still set the standard, so it holds rank three on the strength of what it delivers in the hand. The value line simply reflects the new sticker. The Switch 2 stays at the top for me because it pairs a bright 7.9 inch HDR panel with a library nobody else can match, and the price feels fair for what you actually play. The ROG Xbox Ally X keeps second place as the Windows handheld I reach for first, thanks to the full screen Xbox experience and grip prongs that make long sessions comfortable. I am also watching the MSI Claw 8 EX AI Plus, which lands June 23, and the first Intel Arc G3 handhelds rolling out through the year. Neither is here yet, so I am holding the order steady until I can test them against the field. If you are buying today and you live inside Steam, the Deck is still the answer. If you want the widest catalog at a friendly price, the Switch 2 wins.

The Switch 2 keeps first on the strength of its library and battery balance, and the ROG Xbox Ally X holds second as the performance king with its Ryzen Z2 Extreme, 24GB of RAM, and up to 35W plugged in. If you want raw frames, that is the machine. If you want to spend the least, look at the Legion Go S. The Deck is still wonderful, it just costs Deck-plus-a-lot now.

The Switch 2 turns on instantly, every game runs correctly at a known resolution and frame rate, and the battery lasts a full session. Switch 2 秒開，每款遊戲都在已知的解析度與幀數下正確運作，電池撐得完一個遊戲時段。Windows 掌機要你管驅動、管每款遊戲的設定、管電源設定檔，這件事對某些玩家很有趣，對其他人就是稅。

Lenovo Legion Go 2 第三，螢幕是這個品類最好的，可拆手把讓它更多用途。MSI Claw 8 AI+ 第四，Intel 陣營的選擇，跑輕量遊戲時的續航最重要的話選它。

我的推薦取決於一個問題，你想玩遊戲，還是想調一台掌上型 PC。兩個答案都成立，只是會通向不同的購買。在沙發上玩二十分鐘就是你的模式的話，買 Switch 2。你有四百款 Steam 遊戲又享受折騰設定的話，買 Ally X。

en.commentary: PC Gamer refreshed its handheld recommendations on July 26 and named the MSI Claw 8 EX AI+ its new best high-performance pick, which is the one change I am reflecting this week. I have raised the Claw's performance score to 9.2 and its overall to 8.6, and it holds fourth. Independent testing consistently puts the Intel-based Claw ahead on raw throughput, and that recognition is now broad enough to score. The rest of the table stands. The Switch 2 keeps first place and I want to defend that against the inevitable objection that it is the slowest device here. It is, and it is also the only one where you press a button and a game starts. A 9.5 library score and a 9.5 value score against a 8.5 performance score describes exactly the trade most buyers should make. Windows handhelds are more capable machines and they ask you to manage drivers, launchers, scaling, and a desktop operating system on a screen too small for it. The ROG Xbox Ally X at second is the Windows handheld I recommend, and it is worth noting that PC Gamer's July list also has it at the top of that category with the base Ally as the budget pick. Lenovo's Legion Go 2 holds third on the strength of a 9.6 display, which is genuinely the best screen in this table. Acer's Predator Atlas 8 arrives in October and will reopen this conversation.

en.commentary: Switch 2 keeps first place because it wins on the thing handhelds are actually for: playing games on a couch or a train without thinking about settings. The library, the battery behavior, and the instant sleep and resume are all tuned around portable play in a way no Windows handheld matches. That said, the PC handheld tier moved this week. PC Gamer updated its rankings on July 26 to name the ROG Xbox Ally X the best overall handheld PC, with the standard Ally taking the budget slot and the MSI Claw 8 EX AI+ leading on raw performance. I have raised the Ally X score to reflect that, and it stays second overall. The Ally X earns it through the Xbox full screen experience, which finally gives a Windows handheld a console style front end that boots straight into games. Legion Go 2 holds third on its detachable controllers and larger display. One market force deserves a warning. GPU and RAM pricing has climbed sharply on AI datacenter demand, and handheld pricing is following. Intel's Arc G3 Extreme brings 14 cores and 12 Xe GPU cores to this segment, and the performance gains at Computex arrived with visibly higher price tags.

highlights.title: Switch 2 stays first because it removes every decision except which game to play
highlights.body: Sleep and resume is instant, battery behavior is predictable, and no game asks you to pick a resolution scaler. On a train or a sofa, that consistency is the entire point of a handheld, and it is why the console still leads a field of more powerful Windows machines.

highlights.title: The ROG Xbox Ally X is now the best Windows handheld, and the Xbox front end is why
highlights.body: PC Gamer moved it to best overall handheld PC on July 26. The Xbox full screen experience boots straight into a games library instead of a desktop, which removes the single biggest friction point Windows handhelds have carried since the category started.

highlights.title: Handheld prices are rising, so buy at a discount rather than waiting for the next generation
highlights.body: GPU and RAM costs have climbed sharply on AI datacenter demand and Computex hardware arrived with higher price tags attached. Waiting for a next generation part means paying into a rising market. Current generation hardware on discount is the better play right now.

en.commentary:
I cut the Steam Deck OLED's value score to 4.8 this week and dropped it to sixth, and I want to be direct about why. Valve has raised Steam Deck pricing by as much as $300 as the memory shortage bites. The hardware did not change. The panel is still excellent, the ergonomics are still the best in the category at 9.5, and the library score is still 9.5. What changed is that you now pay flagship money for 2023 silicon. That is a value judgment, and value is a scored factor here.

This reprices the entire category. Handhelds carry 16GB to 32GB of LPDDR5 in a chassis with no upgrade path, so the DRAM spike hits them harder than desktops where you can at least buy RAM separately. Every device on this list is more expensive than it was six months ago for identical performance.

That is why the Nintendo Switch 2 holds first at 9.2 with a 9.6 value score. Nintendo sells a console at console margins with a first-party library nobody else can offer, and it is the one device here insulated from the PC component market.

The ROG Xbox Ally X stays second at 9.1 on a 9.5 performance score and is the right pick if you want a real PC library in your hands. The Legion Go 2's 9.6 display remains the best panel in the category.

highlights.title: The Steam Deck's $300 price increase is a real downgrade to its case
highlights.body: Valve raised Steam Deck pricing by as much as $300 on component costs, and the hardware inside is unchanged. A 9.5 ergonomics score and 9.5 library score still make it lovely to hold and to use. Paying near-flagship money for 2023-era silicon is a different proposition than the one that made it a default recommendation, so its value score falls to 4.8.

highlights.title: Handhelds absorb the memory spike worse than desktops
highlights.body: These devices carry 16GB to 32GB of LPDDR5 soldered into a sealed chassis with no upgrade path. Desktop builders facing the same DRAM increase can at least stage their purchases or reuse existing kits. Handheld buyers pay the full component increase up front and permanently, which is why identical performance costs more across this entire ranking than it did six months ago.

highlights.title: The Switch 2 wins this month by sitting outside the PC component market
highlights.body: A 9.6 value score is the highest here and it exists because Nintendo sells hardware at console economics with a first-party library that no PC handheld can replicate. While every Windows and SteamOS device on this list absorbs GPU and DRAM inflation, the Switch 2's price has held. Stability is a feature in a quarter like this one.

zh-tw.commentary:
這週我把 Steam Deck OLED 的 CP 值砍到 4.8、名次掉到第六，理由講清楚。Valve 因為記憶體缺貨，把 Steam Deck 的售價調漲了最多三百美金。硬體一點都沒變，面板還是很棒，人體工學 9.5 分依然是全品類最好，遊戲庫 9.5 分也沒動。改變的是你現在要用接近旗艦的價錢，買 2023 年的晶片。這就是 CP 值的判斷，而 CP 值在這裡是計分項目。

這件事把整個品類重新定價了。掌機把 16GB 到 32GB 的 LPDDR5 焊在完全封閉、沒有升級路徑的機殼裡，所以 DRAM 漲價對它的傷害比桌機還重，桌機至少你可以分批買記憶體，或是沿用手上的舊條。這份榜單上每一台機器，同樣的效能都比半年前貴。

這就是 Nintendo Switch 2 用 9.6 的 CP 值守住第一、9.2 分的原因。任天堂用主機的利潤結構在賣硬體，第一方遊戲陣容別人給不了，而且它是這裡唯一不受 PC 零組件市場影響的機器。

ROG Xbox Ally X 守第二、9.1 分，效能 9.5，想在手上跑真正的 PC 遊戲庫就選它。Legion Go 2 的螢幕 9.6 分還是全品類最好的面板。

highlights.title: Steam Deck 漲三百美金，對它的說服力是實質降級
highlights.body: Valve 因零組件成本把 Steam Deck 調漲最多三百美金，機器裡面完全沒變。人體工學 9.5 分跟遊戲庫 9.5 分讓它拿在手上依然舒服好用。但用接近旗艦的價錢買 2023 年世代的晶片，跟當初讓它成為預設推薦的那個提案已經是兩回事，所以 CP 值掉到 4.8。

highlights.title: 掌機吃記憶體漲價吃得比桌機還慘
highlights.body: 這些機器把 16GB 到 32GB 的 LPDDR5 焊死在封閉機殼裡，完全沒有升級路徑。同樣面對 DRAM 漲價，組桌機的人至少可以分批採購或沿用舊記憶體。掌機買家一次把整段零件漲幅付掉，而且付了就是永久，這就是這整份榜單上同樣效能都比半年前貴的原因。

highlights.title: Switch 2 這個月贏在它站在 PC 零組件市場外面
highlights.body: CP 值 9.6 是全榜最高，原因是任天堂用主機的經濟模式賣硬體，第一方遊戲陣容沒有任何 PC 掌機複製得了。這份榜單上每一台 Windows 跟 SteamOS 機器都在吸收顯卡與記憶體的通膨，Switch 2 的價格沒動。在這種一季裡，價格穩定本身就是一項功能。

en.commentary: The Switch 2 stays first at 9.2 and this is the most time-sensitive recommendation on the site right now. Nintendo has confirmed the Switch 2 rises to $499.99 on September 1, which gives you under four weeks to buy at the current price. I have cut its value subscore to 8.6 to reflect where it lands after that date, and the ranking still holds because the library and the hardware experience remain the strongest package in handheld gaming. If a Switch 2 is anywhere on your list for this year, buy it in August. The wider context explains why this is happening across the whole category. DRAM and NVMe storage costs are driving hardware price increases everywhere: the Xbox Series X moved to $799.99 on August 1 and the PS5 is at $649. Valve still has not announced a price or firm date for the Steam Frame, and multiple reports trace that delay to memory supply rather than manufacturing, with Qualcomm chip pricing now adding further pressure. The ROG Xbox Ally X at 9.1 remains the best Windows handheld and the pick for anyone who wants their existing PC library in their hands. The Legion Go 2 at 8.8 has the best screen in the category. The Steam Deck OLED at 8.2 is still the most comfortable to hold and the easiest to live with, and at its price it remains the sensible entry point into PC handheld gaming.

highlights.title: Buy a Switch 2 before September 1
highlights.body: Nintendo has confirmed the price rises to $499.99 on September 1. That is a hard deadline with a real number attached, and it is the clearest buying instruction on this site this month. If a Switch 2 is on your list for this year, buy it in August.

highlights.title: Memory costs are repricing the entire console market
highlights.body: The Xbox Series X moved to $799.99 on August 1 and the PS5 sits at $649. DRAM and NVMe storage are the cited cause. Console pricing historically fell over a generation, and that pattern has now reversed for the first time in decades.

highlights.title: The Steam Frame delay is a supply story, not a hardware one
highlights.body: Valve still has no announced price or firm date, and reporting traces the hold to memory supply rather than manufacturing problems, with Qualcomm chip increases adding pressure. Anyone waiting on it should plan for a higher launch price than early estimates suggested.

highlights.title: The ROG Xbox Ally X is the pick for an existing PC library
highlights.body: At 9.1 it runs the games you already own without a store migration or a compatibility layer to think about. For anyone with years of PC purchases behind them, that single fact outweighs the polish advantage the Switch holds elsewhere.

en.commentary: Nintendo Switch 2 holds first at 9.2 and the argument for it has nothing to do with raw performance, which is where most handheld comparisons go wrong. What Nintendo delivers is a device where every game in the library runs correctly at a consistent frame rate with no configuration, and where the battery life is predictable because the software is optimised for exactly this hardware. Every Windows handheld on this board asks you to manage graphics settings, TDP limits, and driver updates before you play, and that overhead is a real cost measured in the time between picking up the device and actually enjoying it. For a handheld specifically, which people use in twenty minute windows on a commute, that difference dominates. ROG Xbox Ally X second at 9.1 is the best Windows handheld and the correct choice if your priority is playing your existing Steam and Game Pass library rather than Nintendo exclusives. Its Xbox full-screen experience genuinely reduces the desktop-on-a-handheld friction that has plagued this category. Lenovo Legion Go 2 third at 8.8 with detachable controllers and a superb display. Legion Go S with SteamOS at 8.5 is the pick for anyone who wants Steam Deck software with newer hardware. My practical advice for Taiwan: check the MicroSD Express requirement on Switch 2 before buying storage, because standard MicroSD cards do not work. No rank or score changes today.

highlights.title: Zero configuration is the specification that matters for a handheld
highlights.body: Handhelds get used in twenty minute windows, so time spent adjusting graphics settings and TDP limits is time not spent playing. Every game on the Switch 2 runs correctly at a consistent frame rate with predictable battery life and no setup. That overhead difference is why it holds first at 9.2 despite lower raw performance.

highlights.title: Switch 2 requires MicroSD Express, not standard MicroSD
highlights.body: Standard cards do not work in the Switch 2, and MicroSD Express costs considerably more per gigabyte. Budget for the correct card type when you buy the console rather than discovering the incompatibility with a drawer full of old cards. This catches a large number of buyers who assume the format carried over.

highlights.title: Buy the Ally X if your library already exists on Steam
highlights.body: The ROG Xbox Ally X plays your existing Steam and Game Pass catalogue rather than requiring new purchases, and its Xbox full-screen experience genuinely reduces the desktop-on-a-handheld friction that has defined Windows handhelds. For someone with a large PC library, that access is worth more than Nintendo exclusives, and 9.1 reflects it.

highlights.title: Weight matters more on a handheld than anywhere else
highlights.body: A device held in both hands for a two hour session produces fatigue that a desktop or a laptop never does, and the heaviest handhelds on this board are meaningfully harder to hold through a long session. Check the weight figure alongside the performance numbers, because comfort determines how long you actually play.

en.commentary:
This has become the year that memory prices reshaped a whole product category, and I am adjusting my scores to reflect it. The Switch 2 keeps first place on the strength of its library, its 7.9 inch HDR panel, and the fact that it is the only handheld here that also works as a living room console at 4K through the dock. I am trimming its value score to 8.4 and its overall to 9.1 because a price increase lands in September, and a ranking that ignores what you will actually pay next month is not much use to anyone.

Context matters here. Valve raised Steam Deck OLED prices back in May, citing memory and storage costs driven by AI server demand, taking the 512GB model from 549 to 789 dollars and the 1TB from 649 to 949. That is why the Steam Deck OLED sits sixth with a 4.8 value score despite having what I still consider the best display and the best ergonomics in the category. The hardware is excellent. The math is what moved.

The ROG Xbox Ally X stays second and is arguably the most interesting machine on this list right now, because as of this month you can buy ASUS hardware and run either the Xbox full screen experience on Windows 11 or a Big Picture style SteamOS setup. That flexibility is real value in a market where software choice used to be locked to the badge on the shell.

Worth watching: Acer is entering seriously with the Predator Atlas 8 built around Intel's Arc G3 Extreme. A credible third silicon vendor is the best thing that could happen to handheld pricing right now.

highlights.title: Switch 2 value trimmed ahead of a September price rise
highlights.body: I lowered the value score to 8.4 and the overall to 9.1. It keeps first place on library breadth, the 7.9 inch HDR panel, and 4K docked output, but the sticker is going up next month.

highlights.title: Memory prices reshaped the whole category
highlights.body: Valve's May increase took the Steam Deck OLED 512GB from 549 to 789 dollars and the 1TB from 649 to 949, citing AI server demand for memory and storage. Hence a 4.8 value score on otherwise excellent hardware.

highlights.title: The ROG Xbox Ally X now offers software choice
highlights.body: As of this month you can run the Xbox full screen experience on Windows 11 or a SteamOS style setup on the same ASUS hardware. Decoupling software from the shell is genuine added value.

highlights.title: Steam Deck OLED still wins on feel
highlights.body: The best display and the best ergonomics here, with a 9.5 on both. If you find one at the old price, buy it immediately.

highlights.title: Acer's Predator Atlas 8 is worth watching
highlights.body: Built around Intel's Arc G3 Extreme, it brings a credible third silicon vendor into handhelds, which is the most likely route back to sane pricing.

en.commentary:
The Switch 2 and the ROG Xbox Ally X sit tied at 9.1 and that tie is the honest answer to a question people keep asking wrongly. These are not competing products. The Switch 2 is a console with a library, a battery that lasts a flight, and a weight you can hold for two hours. The Ally X is a PC that fits in your hands, plays your existing Steam library, and asks you to accept PC-shaped compromises in exchange.

What has changed in 2026 is that premium Windows handhelds now regularly exceed a thousand dollars. At that price the comparison is no longer against a console, it is against a gaming laptop, and the handheld has to justify itself on portability alone.

The Legion Go 2 Gen 2 at 8.8 is the most interesting Windows option because Lenovo shipped a SteamOS variant. A controller-first operating system removes most of what makes Windows handhelds frustrating, and the OLED screen with detachable controllers is genuinely versatile hardware.

For Taiwan buyers, weight is the deciding factor more than specs. A handheld you can comfortably hold on a two-hour high speed rail trip gets used. One that makes your wrists ache after forty minutes stays on a shelf.

highlights.title: The tie at 9.1 reflects two different products
highlights.body: The Switch 2 is a console with a library, flight-length battery, and a weight you can hold for two hours. The Ally X is a PC in your hands that plays your Steam library with PC-shaped compromises. Asking which is better skips the question that actually decides it.

highlights.title: Premium Windows handhelds now compete with laptops
highlights.body: When a handheld exceeds a thousand dollars, the comparison stops being against a console and starts being against a gaming laptop. At that price the device has to justify itself on portability alone, which is a much harder argument to win.

highlights.title: SteamOS fixes what makes Windows handhelds frustrating
highlights.body: A controller-first operating system removes the desktop-in-your-hands awkwardness entirely. The Legion Go 2 Gen 2 shipping a SteamOS variant with an OLED screen and detachable controllers makes it the most interesting Windows-adjacent option at 8.8.

highlights.title: Weight decides whether it gets used
highlights.body: A handheld you can comfortably hold for a two-hour high speed rail trip gets played. One that makes your wrists ache after forty minutes lives on a shelf. Check the weight figure before any specification on the box.

zh-tw.commentary:

2026 年真正的變化是，高階 Windows 掌機現在動不動就超過一千美金。到了這個價格，比較對象已經不是主機而是電競筆電，掌機必須單靠可攜性來說服你。

8.8 分的 Legion Go 2 Gen 2 是最有意思的 Windows 選項，因為聯想推出了 SteamOS 版本。以手把為優先的作業系統把 Windows 掌機大部分的煩躁感都拿掉了，OLED 螢幕加上可拆手把也是真的很靈活的硬體。

給台灣買家：決定因素是重量而不是規格。一台你能在高鐵上舒服拿兩小時的掌機才會真的被玩。四十分鐘就讓你手腕痠的那台，會一直放在架上。

highlights.title: 9.1 平手反映的是兩種不同產品
highlights.body: Switch 2 是有遊戲陣容的主機，電池撐得過一趟飛行，重量拿兩小時沒問題。Ally X 是放在你手上的 PC，跑你的 Steam 遊戲庫但要接受 PC 的妥協。問哪台比較好，等於跳過了真正決定答案的那個問題。

en.commentary: I raised the Switch 2 on value today, and there is a deadline attached to that call. Nintendo is moving the price from $449.99 to $499.99 on September 1, 2026, so anyone considering one has about ten days to buy at the current price. At $449.99 with a 7.9 inch HDR LCD that runs up to 120 FPS and a library nothing else can match, it is the strongest value in handheld gaming right now. After September the arithmetic shifts, though I would still rank it first. The ROG Xbox Ally X at $999.99 remains the handheld I recommend to anyone who wants a portable PC rather than a console. Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme, 24GB of LPDDR5X, a 1TB SSD, and a 7 inch 120Hz panel let it run a Steam library rather than a curated store, and the Xbox shell finally makes Windows tolerable on a small screen. The Legion Go 2 at $1,199 sells one thing exceptionally well, which is its 8.8 inch OLED panel at 144Hz with VRR. That is the best display in the category and the reason people pay the premium. What strikes me about 2026 is that handheld PCs stopped being compromises. Battery life, thermals, and software all reached the point where these are primary gaming machines rather than travel accessories.

highlights.title: Buy the Switch 2 before September 1 if you were already considering it
highlights.body: Nintendo raises the price from $449.99 to $499.99 on September 1, 2026. At the current price with a 7.9 inch HDR panel running up to 120 FPS and an unmatched library, it is the best value in handheld gaming, which is why I raised its value score today.

highlights.title: The ROG Xbox Ally X is the portable PC that finally feels finished
highlights.body: Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme, 24GB of LPDDR5X, and a 1TB SSD run your existing Steam library rather than a curated store. The Xbox shell over Windows is what makes a desktop operating system workable on a 7 inch screen.

highlights.title: The Legion Go 2 has the best display in handheld gaming
highlights.body: An 8.8 inch OLED at 144Hz with VRR is genuinely larger and better than anything else here, and it is the single reason the $1,199 price finds buyers. If screen quality drives your purchase, the comparison ends quickly.

highlights.title: 2026 is the year handheld PCs stopped being compromises
highlights.body: Battery life, thermal behavior, and software polish all crossed the line where these machines work as a primary gaming platform. Buying one no longer means accepting a worse version of PC gaming for the sake of portability.

en.commentary: The ROG Xbox Ally X holds first because it pairs the strongest handheld silicon available with a software layer that finally makes Windows handhelds bearable. The historical problem with PC handhelds was never raw performance, it was the ten minutes of desktop wrangling before you reached a game. The Xbox integration collapses that into a console style launch experience while keeping full library access. That combination is what earns the top spot. The Switch 2 at second has the best library situation in handheld gaming and the most polished experience overall, and for most people it remains the correct purchase. The Legion Go 2 Gen 2 at third has the best display in the category and detachable controllers that add real flexibility. The MSI Claw 8 AI+ at fourth delivers strong battery life through efficient silicon, and the Legion Go S running SteamOS at fifth gives you the Steam Deck software experience on newer hardware. Acer holds its Next @ Acer event on September 2 ahead of IFA covering gaming devices, so there may be new handheld options within days. The ranking holds today. Battery life remains the specification I would weight highest for anyone buying to play away from a power outlet.

highlights.title: The software layer was always the PC handheld problem
highlights.body: Raw performance was never the gap. Reaching a game required desktop wrangling first, and the Xbox integration collapses that into a console style launch while keeping full library access.

highlights.title: The Switch 2 is still correct for most people
highlights.body: Best library situation in handheld gaming and the most polished overall experience. Unless you specifically need PC library access, the simpler device delivers more playing time and less configuration.

highlights.title: Weight battery life highest if you play away from power
highlights.body: Every other specification degrades gracefully and battery life does not. A handheld that lasts ninety minutes is a device you play near an outlet, which defeats the form factor entirely.

PC 掌機一直以來的問題從來不是效能，而是你要玩到遊戲之前得先跟桌面環境搏鬥十分鐘。Xbox 的整合把這段壓縮成主機式的啟動體驗，同時保留完整的遊戲庫存取。這個組合就是它排第一的原因。

Switch 2 第二名，掌機領域遊戲陣容的處境最好，整體完成度也最高，對大多數人來說它仍然是正確的選擇。

Legion Go 2 Gen 2 第三名螢幕是這個類別最好的，可拆手把也帶來實際的彈性。

highlights.title: PC 掌機的問題一直都在軟體層
highlights.body: 效能從來不是缺口，問題是玩到遊戲之前得先跟桌面環境搏鬥。Xbox 的整合把這段壓成主機式的啟動流程，同時保住完整遊戲庫。

highlights.title: 對大多數人來說，Switch 2 還是對的

highlights.title: 沒插座就玩的話，續航權重放最高

en.commentary: Handhelds are quietly one of the categories where the memory shortage bites hardest, because these machines are built around soldered LPDDR5 and fixed NVMe storage that you specify once and live with. DDR5 has roughly doubled year over year, NAND contract prices climbed 55 to 60 percent in a quarter, and TrendForce expects the increases to persist through Q4 and into 2027. That makes storage tier selection the most consequential decision you will make on this page, because the difference between a 512GB and a 1TB model today is far smaller than the cost of regretting it later. The ROG Xbox Ally X holds first at 9.1 on the strength of Windows handheld ergonomics finally being solved and the Xbox app integration making library management bearable. The Switch 2 at 9.0 remains the correct answer for anyone whose priority is the games themselves, because Nintendo's exclusives have no substitute anywhere on this list. The Legion Go 2 Gen 2 at 8.8 gives you the best screen in the category. Valve's Steam Deck OLED at 8.2 is still the most comfortable to hold and the most predictable in what it will run, and its pricing has stayed stable through a component market that has punished everyone else.

highlights.title: Choose the larger storage tier, because this decision is permanent
highlights.body: Handhelds use soldered memory and fixed internal storage specified once at purchase. NAND contract prices rose 55 to 60 percent in a quarter with further increases expected through 2027. The upgrade from 512GB to 1TB costs less today than at any point going forward, and modern game installs make that capacity gap disappear quickly.

highlights.title: ROG Xbox Ally X finally makes a Windows handheld feel finished
highlights.body: The ergonomics work, the Xbox app makes a mixed library manageable, and the performance headroom is the highest here. Those three things together are what Windows handhelds have been missing since the format started. At 9.1 this is the machine for someone who wants their whole PC library in their hands.

highlights.title: Buy the Switch 2 for the games, and everything else follows
highlights.body: At 9.0 it is the only device on this list with a library you cannot get anywhere else. Nintendo's first-party output is the entire argument, and it is a strong one. If your handheld time is going to be spent on Mario, Zelda, and Metroid, the specification comparison is beside the point.

highlights.title: Steam Deck OLED has held its price through a punishing component market
highlights.body: At 8.2 it remains the most comfortable device here to hold for two hours and the most predictable about what it will actually run. Valve has kept pricing stable while memory and NAND costs rose across the industry, which is worth acknowledging plainly.

zh-tw.commentary:
掌機其實是這波記憶體短缺咬得最深的類別之一，因為這些機器都是圍繞焊死的 LPDDR5 跟固定的 NVMe 儲存設計的，你只能在購買當下選一次，然後用到底。

DDR5 年增大約翻倍，NAND 合約價單季上漲五成五到六成，TrendForce 預期漲勢延續到第四季甚至 2027 年。這讓「選哪一個儲存容量」變成你在這個頁面上最關鍵的決定，因為今天 512GB 跟 1TB 的差價，遠小於之後後悔的代價。

ROG Xbox Ally X 以 9.1 守住第一，靠的是 Windows 掌機的人體工學終於做對了，加上 Xbox App 整合讓遊戲庫管理變得可以忍受。

9.0 分的 Switch 2，對於把遊戲本身擺第一的人來說仍然是正確答案，因為任天堂的獨佔作品在這份榜單上找不到替代品。

8.8 分的 Legion Go 2 Gen 2 提供這個類別最好的螢幕。8.2 分的 Steam Deck OLED 仍然是最好握的一台，也是最能預期「這款到底跑不跑得動」的一台，而且在這個把大家都修理過一輪的零件行情裡，它的價格一直很穩。

highlights.title: 直接選容量大的那一階，因為這個決定是永久的
highlights.body: 掌機用的是焊死的記憶體跟購買當下就固定的內建儲存。NAND 合約價單季上漲五成五到六成，預期到 2027 年還會續漲。從 512GB 升到 1TB 的價差，今天是往後最便宜的一刻，而現代遊戲的安裝容量會很快把那段差距吃光。

highlights.title: ROG Xbox Ally X 終於讓 Windows 掌機有了完成度
highlights.body: 人體工學做對了，Xbox App 讓混雜的遊戲庫管理得動，效能餘裕也是這裡最高的。這三件事湊在一起，正是 Windows 掌機從問世以來一直缺的東西。9.1 分，這台是給想把整個 PC 遊戲庫帶在手上的人。

highlights.title: 買 Switch 2 是為了遊戲，其他都是附帶的
highlights.body: 9.0 分，它是這份榜單上唯一擁有你在別處拿不到的遊戲庫的機器。任天堂第一方作品就是全部的論點，而這個論點很強。如果你的掌機時間會花在瑪利歐、薩爾達跟銀河戰士上，規格比較這件事就沒那麼重要了。

highlights.title: 在慘烈的零件行情裡，Steam Deck OLED 把價格守住了
highlights.body: 8.2 分，它仍然是這裡連握兩小時最舒服的一台，也是最能預期實際跑得動什麼的一台。在整個產業的記憶體跟 NAND 成本一路上漲的期間，Valve 把定價維持穩定，這件事值得直接講出來肯定。

en.commentary: Acer introduced the Predator Atlas 7 at IFA this week, condensing flagship PC gaming performance into a seven-inch footprint, and the ROG Xbox Ally X20 announced at Computex adds a 7.4-inch Nebula HDR OLED display with drift-resistant TMR joysticks and a transforming D-pad. This category is moving fast and the hardware is genuinely getting better. Nintendo also raised the Switch 2 price to $499.99 on September 1, blamed on memory costs. The ROG Xbox Ally X holds first at 9.1 because it is the handheld where Windows finally stops being the problem. The Xbox full-screen experience boots straight into a console-like interface, and that single software decision removes the friction that made every previous Windows handheld feel like a laptop you play games on. The Switch 2 at 9.0 stays second and the price rise does not move it, because Nintendo's library remains unavailable anywhere else. Legion Go 2 Gen 2 at 8.8 has the best display and detachable controllers. MSI Claw 8 AI+ at 8.6 has excellent battery life from its Intel silicon. Legion Go S with SteamOS at 8.5 is the pick for anyone who wants Steam Deck software on better hardware. Buying advice: TMR joysticks matter. Drift has killed more handhelds than any other failure, and the new sensor type genuinely solves it.

highlights.title: The Xbox full-screen experience fixed Windows handhelds
highlights.body: Booting straight into a console-style interface removes the desktop friction that made previous Windows handhelds feel like laptops. That software decision is why the ROG Xbox Ally X holds first over hardware with similar specifications.

highlights.title: TMR joysticks solve the failure that kills handhelds
highlights.body: Stick drift has ended more handheld consoles than any other fault. The new sensor type in the Ally X20 removes the mechanism that causes it, and that durability should be a checklist item on any purchase now.

highlights.title: The Switch 2 price rise does not change the recommendation
highlights.body: Nintendo's library has no substitute, so the fifty dollar increase changes the value calculation without changing the answer. If you want those games, this is the only device that plays them.

highlights.title: IFA shows the category maturing quickly
highlights.body: Acer's Predator Atlas 7 puts flagship performance in a seven-inch body, and OLED displays are becoming a standard fitting across the category. Anyone considering a purchase should expect a meaningfully better device within twelve months.

zh-tw.commentary:
Acer 這週在 IFA 推出 Predator Atlas 7，把旗艦級 PC 遊戲效能塞進七吋機身，而 Computex 發表的 ROG Xbox Ally X20 則配上 7.4 吋 Nebula HDR OLED 螢幕、抗飄移的 TMR 搖桿，還有可變形十字鍵。這個類別跑得很快，硬體是真的在變好。

任天堂也在 9 月 1 日把 Switch 2 調到 499.99 美元，歸因於記憶體成本。

ROG Xbox Ally X 守第一，9.1 分，因為它是 Windows 終於不再是問題的那台掌機。Xbox 全螢幕體驗開機直接進入類主機介面，光這一個軟體決策，就拿掉了讓過去每一台 Windows 掌機都像「一台拿來玩遊戲的筆電」的那層摩擦。

Switch 2 的 9.0 守第二，漲價沒有動搖它，因為任天堂的遊戲庫在別的地方就是買不到。

Legion Go 2 Gen 2 的 8.8 螢幕最好，手把可拆。MSI Claw 8 AI+ 的 8.6 靠 Intel 平台拿到很棒的續航。Legion Go S 的 SteamOS 版 8.5 給想要 Steam Deck 軟體配更好硬體的人。

採購建議，TMR 搖桿很重要。搖桿飄移殺死的掌機比任何其他故障都多，而這個新的感測方式是真的解掉了它。

highlights.title: Xbox 全螢幕體驗修好了 Windows 掌機
highlights.body: 開機直接進入類主機介面，拿掉了讓過去 Windows 掌機像筆電的桌面摩擦。這個軟體決策，就是 ROG Xbox Ally X 能贏過規格相近硬體的原因。

highlights.title: TMR 搖桿解掉了殺死掌機的那個故障
highlights.body: 搖桿飄移終結的掌機比任何其他故障都多。Ally X20 用的新感測方式從機制上消除它，現在買掌機時，這應該列進你的檢查清單。

highlights.title: Switch 2 漲價不影響推薦結論
highlights.body: 任天堂的遊戲庫沒有替代品，所以漲五十美元改變的是價值計算，答案沒有變。你想玩那些遊戲，就只有這台機器能玩。

highlights.title: IFA 顯示這個類別正在快速成熟
highlights.body: Acer 的 Predator Atlas 7 把旗艦效能放進七吋機身，OLED 螢幕也從高階配備變成標準配備。正在考慮入手的人，可以預期十二個月內會出現明顯更好的機器。
